[Act: human-rights
 Chapter: The National Human Rights Commission
 Section: 9::Vacancies, etc., not to invalidate the proceedings of the Commission.
]


No act or proceedings of the Commission shall be questioned or shall be invalidated merely on the ground of existence of any vacancy or defect in the constitution of the Commission.

metadata.section_title: Vacancies, etc., not to invalidate the proceedings of the Commission.
